say:0:1028444001:0.text: Chippy saw it! There was a stag with large antlers over there!
say:0:1028444001:0.source_cn: 满满望见了，前面有只长角的公鹿！

say:1:1028444002:0.text: The next step is to use the antler flute and lure it back to the cabin.
say:1:1028444002:0.source_cn: 接下来只要吹响鹿笛，引它回老师的小屋就好。
